instagram.caption:
The good towels.
The Guest Linen Zone in the Guest Bathroom. It holds one complete fresh set of towels so hosting never starts with a search.

What done looks like:
1. One bundle per expected guest, each holding a bath towel, a hand towel, and a washcloth folded together, matching in color, smelling of nothing at all
2. A clean bath mat folded flat beneath the bundles
3. A hand's width of air above the stack
4. No thin gray towel kept for the dog sharing the shelf

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success guest linen zone.
